name: registers-ready-made
description: All five ready-made registers can be added; the hand-made Malaria register does not count as the ready-made one

name: register-opd
assert: window.designAudit.path.startsWith('/registers/')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Every visit adds a row')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Demo Second Patient')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Malaria RDT: Positive')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Sent home')&&!document.body.innerText.includes('to complete')&&!document.body.innerText.includes('Add entry')
description: The general outpatient register is filled from the visits, with nothing for staff to add

name: register-malaria
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('Visits whose diagnosis, tests or results mention malaria')&&document.body.innerText.includes('1 visit in')&&document.body.innerText.includes('1 to complete')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Malaria RDT: Positive')&&document.body.innerText.includes('Artemether-lumefantrine')&&document.body.innerText.includes('38.6 °C')&&!document.body.innerText.includes('Amaka Okoro')
description: Only the malaria visit fills the malaria register: RDT result, diagnosis, antimalarial and outcome come from the visit

name: register-complete-sheet
description: Completing a row asks only for the fields the visit does not hold
The staff fields are saved as an entry naming the visit, and the row is complete

name: register-configure
description: The builder shows which visits fill the register and where each field comes from
Added ready-made registers are marked, and their cards say they fill from visits

name: register-monthly
description: The monthly report counts the visits in each register

name: register-phone
description: A register filled from visits fits a 320px phone
